# fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job_run (Resource)

Runs a Backup Native VM backup job once, outside its schedule, the same operation as "Start backup" in the portal. Applying the resource checks the job's status, starts the run and waits for it to end. A job that is still running a backup, a restore or a change fails the apply at once, without starting a run. Destroying the resource only removes it from state. Change a value in `triggers` to run the backup again. A failed run fails the apply and leaves the resource tainted, so the next apply runs it again. A job in state `Failed` refuses a new run until another run starts. When the job stays in `Pending`, the apply runs out its timeout; only a later run or the backend clears that state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Runs fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job.web once and waits for the run to end.
# Any value works and a new value runs it again. A request time, as below, is
# recommended so the state records when each run was requested. Avoid
# timestamp(): it changes on every plan and runs a backup on every apply.
resource "fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job_run" "web" {
  vpc_id   = var.vpc_id
  job_id   = fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job.web.id
  triggers = { run = "2026-10-26 09:00:00" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_id` (String) ID of the backup job to run, the `id` of a `fptcloud_backup_native_vm_job`.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC that owns the backup job.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that run the backup again when they change, which no other argument can express because every other argument stays equal. Any string works; only a change matters. We recommend the time you ask for the action, in the form `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`, for example `2026-10-26 09:00:00`, so the state records when each one was requested. Avoid `timestamp()`: it changes on every plan and repeats the action on every apply.

### Read-Only

- `finished_at` (String) When the provider saw the run end, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `started_at` (String) When the provider started the run, RFC 3339 UTC.
- `status` (String) The job's status when the run ended, `Success` or `success` after a successful apply.
